coverageContext: Han Chinese TPMI research model, with a broader thyrotoxicosis/orbital-code training definition and a Graves-specific evaluation of 225 cases. Reported performance includes sex, age, array and ancestry covariates; GA computes only the genetic component. EUR reference ranks are withheld. Not a thyroid-hormone or antibody test, diagnosis, medication guide or calibrated personal probability.

Han Chinese TPMI chronic-thyroiditis research score, mapped by the Catalog to Hashimoto thyroiditis, with broader chronic-thyroiditis evaluation codes and 260 evaluation cases. GA does not reproduce the covariate-adjusted study model. EUR ranks are withheld. Not a thyroid-hormone or antibody measurement, a diagnosis, a prediction of current thyroid function or a treatment guide.
